name: railway_list_domains
description: List the domains attached to a service in a given environment: both the Railway-provided domains (serviceDomains: id, domain, suffix, targetPort — the *.up.railway.app hostnames) and the user's customDomains (id, domain, and status.dnsRecords). Use this to see what's already set up before adding a new custom domain, or to find an existing customDomain `id` to pass to railway_get_custom_domain. Requires `projectId`, `environmentId`, and `serviceId` (all from railway_get_project).

body_defaults.query: query domains($projectId: String!, $environmentId: String!, $serviceId: String!) { domains(projectId: $projectId, environmentId: $environmentId, serviceId: $serviceId) { serviceDomains { id domain suffix targetPort } customDomains { id domain status { dnsRecords { hostlabel recordType requiredValue currentValue status } } } } }
